summary.zh: 读取用户明确选择的本地业务材料，识别SAP岗位、流程和日常操作，并匹配现有Agent、组合工作流或能力缺口。
summary.en: Reads explicitly selected local business documents, identifies SAP roles, processes and daily operations, and maps them to agents, composed workflows, or capability gaps.

zh: 多轮补充材料与业务反馈
en: Multi-turn supplemental material and business feedback

zh: 带来源引用的分析报告
只读取用户明确选择的路径
不执行宏、公式、外部链接或嵌入代码
正文仅保存在本机.local-data目录
不修改原始文档、SAP数据、Agent或工作流
en: Reads only paths explicitly selected by the user
Does not execute macros, formulas, external links, or embedded code
Document text remains under the local .local-data directory
Does not modify source documents, SAP data, agents, or workflows

description.zh: 安全扫描用户指定路径并提取带位置引用的正文。
description.en: Safely scans user-selected paths and extracts text with source locators.

description.zh: 由Codex Runtime理解SAP业务操作，再由平台复核Agent与工作流建议。
description.en: Codex Runtime understands SAP operations, then the platform verifies agent and workflow suggestions.

purpose.zh: 形成结构化业务理解和候选匹配
purpose.en: Produces structured business understanding and candidate matches

description.zh: 用户可增量补充材料或全量重算，历史修订保持不可变。
description.en: Users can add materials incrementally or fully recompute while prior revisions remain immutable.

purpose.zh: 保存修订、来源和完整性
